'''[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Eddels''' was an alias used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Qordis]] when embezzling funds from the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] before the [[Ruusan campaign]]. He used this money to purchase ancient artifacts.

[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] would later use this name when dealing with Qordis' old [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] contact in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].
